name: Captain's Chair Knee Raise
steps: Rest your forearms on the captain's chair pads, grasp the handles firmly, and press your back flat against the backrest.
Let your legs hang straight down with your shoulders depressed away from your ears.
Exhale and curl both bent knees upward toward your chest while rounding your pelvis slightly at the top.
Lower your legs slowly back to the hanging start without letting your torso swing.
tips: Curl your pelvis slightly upward at the top to engage your abs rather than only flexing your hips.
Press actively through your forearms so your shoulders stay packed down throughout the set.
